data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release of GBP 25.251 million for prior year development, primarily driven by a GBP 24.686 million profit attributable to the 2020 underwriting year and a GBP 0.565 million profit attributable to the 2019 and prior years. This overall release is a mixed result, as the 2019 pure year of account generated a GAAP profit of GBP 19.001 million, while the 2018 and prior years experienced a GAAP loss of GBP 4.640 million due to strengthening of the Casualty UK account following an in-depth actuarial assessment. The 2021 pure year of account also benefited from a benign year with minimal large loss activity.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is derived from the 'Profit / (loss) attributable to underwriting years of account' table, which represents the net profit/loss emerging from prior years in the current reporting period. This is a net figure (after reinsurance). The claims development triangle indicates a gross strengthening of GBP 5.614m for years 2019 and prior, which differs from the P&L attribution.
